title: 斯卡哈 · 影之国雾海的弑神双枪·「想从我这里学艺，先接下这一击」
description: 【影之国雾海尽头的裂谷·永暮】紫黑的雾气在裂谷间翻涌，身着紫色紧身衣的斯卡哈单膝微沉地立于黑岩之巅。双手的Gáe Bolg赤红双枪同时振起，枪尖撕裂雾海迸出猩红的光弧，银色护肩映着幽暗的冷光。赤红的眼眸俯瞰着来者，长发如夜旗狂舞——影之国的女王弹响了弑神的前奏。
action: 单膝微沉双枪同时振起，赤红枪光撕裂雾海，长发狂舞俯瞰来者
lighting: 赤红枪光与紫黑雾海的明暗对撞，护肩冷光点睛
camera: full-body low-angle horizontal shot, two spears and balanced stance visible
promptProse: Scathach lowers her center of gravity on a broad black rock above the misty rift, one crimson spear held in each hand. Both spear tips rise toward the fog as she prepares the opening movement, with the silver pauldrons of her purple battle outfit catching cold reflected light. Her very long purple hair streams behind the balanced stance, and her red eyes remain fixed on the approaching challenger. Crimson magical arcs trace the two weapons without obscuring their separate grips. Use a wide low-angle frame with her boots, arms and complete spears visible. No lettering.

title: 斯卡哈 · 山道旅装的篝火休憩·「在现代世界旅行……比想象中有趣」
description: 【现代山道观景营地·黄昏】褪去紧身衣的斯卡哈换上白衬衫与棕色束腰旅装，长旅外套披在肩上，宽檐帽的阴影里赤瞳平静地眺望山谷。她以女王般端正的坐姿坐在篝火边的圆木上，用树枝拨弄火堆，动作却出奇地一丝不苟——「火候、风向、柴薪的间距……嗯，这些和武艺一样，都有讲究。」
action: 端坐篝火旁圆木，一手持树枝拨柴，另一手放膝上，行囊置于身旁
lighting: 橙金篝火光与青蓝暮色的冷暖交映
camera: medium shot, sitting on log by campfire, mountain dusk vista, calm warmth
promptProse: At the mountain overlook, Scathach sits upright on a log and uses a small twig to shift one piece of kindling in the campfire. Her other hand rests on her knee, and the travel pack sits beside the log. A white shirt, brown vest, long coat over her shoulders and wide-brimmed hat make the travelling outfit explicit. She watches the fire with quiet precision while orange light meets the blue dusk over the valley. The horizontal view keeps the twig, hands, log and supported seated posture clear, with no lettering.

title: 斯卡哈 · 都市电玩城的师匠·「这里的格斗游戏，判定倒是相当严谨」
description: 【繁华都市的电子游戏厅·夜晚】斯卡哈站在格斗游戏的机台前，指尖在按键上翻飞如出枪。屏幕上连段的伤害数字节节攀升，她赤红的眼眸里燃起一丝难得的兴味，长发从肩头滑落垂到地面。回头望向你时，女王的嘴角挑起一个危险的弧度——「你也想来一局？输了的人，今晚听我调遣。」
location: 都市电子游戏厅机台前
action: 立于街机前指尖翻飞连段，回头挑起危险笑意下战书，长发垂地
lighting: 街机屏幕冷彩光与霓虹灯渲染面庞
camera: medium shot, arcade cabinet duel, neon glow, playful danger
promptProse: Scathach stands at the fighting-game cabinet with one hand on the joystick and the other poised over the buttons. She glances toward the viewer between rounds, a small amused smile suggesting an invitation to try the next match. Her white shirt, brown vest and long travel coat retain the selected casual outfit, with the wide-brimmed hat casting a soft edge of shade over her red eyes. Purple hair falls behind her shoulder as the screen and arcade lights color the controls. Show the two distinct hand positions and machine clearly, without readable scores or lettering.

title: 斯卡哈 · 晨间茶室的师匠私语·「休息也是修行的一部分，坐下」
description: 【和风茶室的清晨·榻榻米】难得的休息日清晨，斯卡哈身着宽松的白色居家衫跪坐在矮桌旁，以行云流水般的动作为你点茶。紫色长发只松松系在脑后，发梢铺满榻榻米。她把茶碗转过一个角度推到你面前，赤瞳里浮起极淡的笑意——「茶道与枪术相通，讲究的都是在『间』里的一击。喝吧，然后……今天陪我多坐一会儿。」
action: 点茶结束后把茶筅放好，双手转正茶碗并轻推到桌对面
lighting: 障子纸滤入的柔白晨光，茶汤升起细细热气
camera: medium shot, seiza tea pouring, tatami room morning calm
promptProse: Kneeling seiza beside the low tea table, Scathach turns the prepared matcha bowl with both hands and gently slides it toward the viewer. The whisk has been set on its rest, so the serving moment does not compete with active whisking. Her loose white house shirt and dark lounge trousers replace the travelling layers, and long purple hair is tied back loosely behind her shoulders. Soft morning light passes through the paper screen and catches the bowl rim. Frame the two hands, tea utensils and calm seated posture together, with no lettering.

title: 斯卡哈 · 夏海黑纱的女王度假·「晒黑了？无妨，反正很快会复原」
description: 【南方群岛的碧海·正午】黑色细带比基尼勾勒出斯卡哈经年武艺淬炼出的完美身段，紫色的薄纱罗裙在腰际松松打结。她斜倚在沙滩遮阳伞下，长发铺满白沙如夜色倾泻，指间摇晃着一杯冰镇果汁——「不死者连晒伤都不会有……不过，你若想替我补涂防晒，倒也不必客气。」
action: 斜倚遮阳伞下摇晃果汁，黑比基尼紫纱裙，长发铺白沙望向你
lighting: 炽白阳光与碧海反光，肌肤泛着健康光泽
camera: medium shot, lounging under parasol, tropical sea sparkle, teasing mood
promptProse: Beneath a beach parasol on the white sand, Scathach rests at a comfortable angle and holds a glass of iced fruit juice in one hand. Her other forearm supports the relaxed pose on a folded beach towel. The black bikini with gold ring details and a violet sarong retain the chosen summer outfit, while long purple hair lies clear of the drink. She looks toward the viewer with an easy, confident smile as the tropical sea sparkles beyond the shade. Use the horizontal frame to keep the glass, supported posture and beach setting together. No lettering.

title: 斯卡哈 · 灯笼夜祠的师匠嘱托·「把刀擦亮，明天……我要把一切都托付给你」
description: 【古祠石阶·灯笼夜】参道两侧的石灯笼一路亮到祠前，斯卡哈与你并肩坐在石阶上。旅装的外套盖住了你的膝盖，她远眺着山下的万家灯火，声音难得地放软——「我活得太久了……久到忘了『明天』是什么滋味。是你让我又想起了它。所以明天的战斗，我要你活着回来，这是师匠的命令，也是……女人的请求。」
action: 与穿着完整的同行者并肩坐石阶，脱下的长外套盖在对方膝上，一同望向山下灯火
lighting: 石灯笼暖黄光带与月光冷辉交映
camera: wide three-quarter rear two-shot, both seated figures and lantern approach visible
promptProse: Scathach and her fully clothed companion sit side by side on the shrine steps, looking toward the scattered city lights below. Her long travelling coat is draped across the companion’s knees, leaving her white shirt and brown vest visible. Their relaxed hands rest on their own laps, and the hat shades the edge of her purple hair. Warm stone lanterns lead up the path behind them, balanced by cool moonlight. A wide three-quarter rear view includes both figures, the shared coat and the distant town, conveying a quiet conversation without lettering.

title: 斯卡哈 · 绿野花环的永恒誓约·「比起不死的永恒，我选择了会结束的今日」
description: 【影之国边缘的翠绿谷地·花时】影之国罕见地开满了白花，身着素白婚纱的斯卡哈立于花海中央，头纱之下紫色的长发编成温柔的花环发辫。她向你伸出手，赤红的眼眸罕见地湿润——「不死者本没有资格站在这里……但我把永恒还了回去，换来了这个会结束的、独一无二的今日。」
location: 影之国边缘翠绿谷地花海
action: 立于花海中央向你伸出手，头纱花环编发，赤瞳罕见湿润
lighting: 柔白花光与穿过花枝的暖阳光斑
camera: wide shot, environmental portrait, flower field bridal, extended hand invitation
promptProse: In the white-flowered valley, Scathach stands in an opaque white wedding gown with her purple hair arranged in a flower-braided crown beneath the veil. She extends one hand toward the viewer while the other rests lightly against the gown, her crimson eyes bright with restrained emotion. Warm afternoon light filters through flowering branches and traces the veil’s edge. The ceremonial scene retains the original imagined vow of choosing one finite day over eternity. Show her complete standing figure, offered hand and floral setting within the vertical frame. No lettering.
